attributes.action: Legislate now to completely eliminate the gender pay gap.
attributes.additional_details: I seriously don’t believe that something as small as gender should have an effect on pay in jobs by 12.8% and actually don’t think that our pay should be defined by gender anyway. Please change this so what we leave behind for our children is not prejudice and discrimination against a gender as a whole but instead an equal society teaching them that we should all accept and support one and another.
attributes.background: Closing the 12.8% UK gender pay gap will add £55bn to our economy. Parliament must legislate immediately to boost business productivity, lift working families out of poverty, and completely end the unfair motherhood penalty for a much fairer and Prosperous future and change society as we know it.

rejection.details: There is already legislation in place to tackle this - we do not know what the nature is of the new legislation you are calling for.
